messages:
Tara V: quick check — canary from last night exposed ambiguous 502/503 responses to clients when routing to fallback. Console shows 'degraded' badge but SDK surfaces 502. Anyone seen this?
Liam H: saw a couple of hits. looks like router returned a `502` when it hit the 'fallback' path for model variants, but our client-layer translates that to generic network error.
Maya R: can you paste an example response body? curious if we have `x-redwood-hint` or `retry-after` set.
Tara V: here are a couple raw responses from the canary: 
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
X-Redwood-Mode: fallback
X-Server-Reason: model_unavailable
{ "error": { "code": "MODEL_UNAVAILABLE", "message": "Primary model overloaded, using fallback" } }
```
and another: 
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json
Retry-After: 2
{ "error": { "code": "TRANSIENT_CAPACITY", "message": "Temporary capacity issue" } }
```
Evan S: ah. router uses 502 when upstream (model runtime) returned non-200, 503 when router itself degrades. that inconsistency makes client SDK ambiguous.
Liz (PM): for UX we want clients to be able to distinguish: transient vs permanent vs fallback. i'd vote: 503 = transient/retryable, 502 = upstream-broken (non-retry), 424 for dependency-failed, 429 quota. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Liam H: +1 on a consistent mapping. we should also include a structured header like `X-Redwood-Status: transient|fallback|permanent` so SDKs don't have to parse codes.
Maya R: prefer `x-redwood-hint` header, values: `retryable`, `fallback`, `degraded`, `quota`. SDK picks behavior from that. keep HTTP code aligned but header is canonical.
Evan S: implementable plan: router emits header, runtime keeps previous op codes, and console mapping reads header to badge: fallback/degraded/ok. we'll need telemetry change: emit `status_bucket` field with values.
Tara V: cc @deploy-bot — can we get a deploy note here? also need a quick canary patch so SDKs can be updated before GA.
deploy-bot: Deploy started for service/router at 2024-03-05T07:12Z (canary).
Liam H: SDK implications: node/python SDKs should prefer header over code for programmatic decisions. fallback => continue streaming but tag provenance, retryable => automatic retry with backoff, permanent => bubble up error. Also expose `redwood_error_code` string in error object.
Maya R: agree. also add `x-redwood-fallback-reason` when fallback used (e.g., `variant_mismatch`, `overloaded`, `cold_start`). small finite set helps console grouping.
Liz (PM): For console: new badge states: green/ok, amber/degraded-fallback, red-unavailable. tooltip displays `status_bucket` + top 2 `fallback_reason`s from telemetry. Can we populate that from canary?
Evan S: yes, telemetry event changes: emit `status_bucket`, `fallback_reason`, `client_impact` (boolean), and `affected_models`. will update ingestion schema.
Tara V: quick RFC blurbs: 1) header canonicalization (`X-Redwood-Hint`), 2) HTTP code alignment doc, 3) telemetry fields. i'll stub a PR to the errors RFC: <https://go/redwood/errors-rfc|errors-rfc>.
Liam H: SDKs also need to preserve idempotency semantics. if retry is automatic, ensure `Idempotency-Key` presence verified or warn in logs.
Maya R: can we add a short example to the RFC?
Maya R: example response for retryable: 
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json
X-Redwood-Hint: retryable
Retry-After: 1
{ "error": { "code": "TRANSIENT_CAPACITY", "message": "Try again" }, "redwood_error_code": "TRANSIENT_CAPACITY" }
```
Tara V: perfect. action items: Liam -> SDK header-first behavior PR, Evan -> telemetry ingestion change + schema, Maya -> update RFC examples, Liz -> console badge copy, Tara -> router small change to emit `X-Redwood-Hint`. can we target a staged rollout this week?
Liam H: i can do SDK PR today, tagging it `canary-ready`.
Evan S: telemetry PR in progress, should be ready by EOD for canary ingestion.
Maya R: RFC PR in draft now.
Liz (PM): i'll prep console mockups and a short note for self-serve customers about 'degraded' badge meaning.
Tara V: thanks all. follow-up sync in #eng-platform tomorrow 10am to confirm canary metrics. :thumbsup:
